"""Exact C158196 visible non-governing signal capture; CPU check never contacts CARLA."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

from signal_control import CAMERA_SIZES, CAMERAS, find_governing_signal, run_signal_capture


PREFIX = "testing__C158196__NRS-484B-257-1__motor_vehicle_driver__"
PRIMARY = PREFIX + "signal_visible_not_governing"
SITE = Path(__file__).with_name("signal-visible-site.xodr")


def validate_authored_site(path=SITE):
    """Check a signed ego entrance and a distinct through-lane signal head."""
    root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
    if root.tag != "OpenDRIVE":
        raise ValueError("Signal site is not OpenDRIVE")
    roads = {road.get("id"): road for road in root.findall("road")}
    if set(roads) != {"158190", "158192", "158193", "158194", "158195", "158196"}:
        raise ValueError("Signed intersection roads differ")
    if any(roads[road].get("junction") != "158191" for road in ("158192", "158195")):
        raise ValueError("Signal site junction geometry differs")
    lanes = roads["158190"].findall("./lanes/laneSection/right/lane")
    if len(lanes) != 1 or lanes[0].get("id") != "-1" or lanes[0].get("type") != "driving":
        raise ValueError("Signed ego approach is not one-way")
    ego_signals = roads["158190"].findall("./signals/signal")
    through_signals = roads["158194"].findall("./signals/signal")
    if (len(ego_signals) != 1 or ego_signals[0].get("type") != "205" or
            ego_signals[0].get("dynamic") != "no" or len(through_signals) != 1):
        raise ValueError("Signed entrance or distinct through signal missing")
    sign, head = ego_signals[0], through_signals[0]
    if (head.get("type") != "1000001" or head.get("dynamic") != "yes" or
            head.get("id") == sign.get("id") or
            head.find("validity") is None or
            (head.find("validity").get("fromLane"), head.find("validity").get("toLane")) != ("-1", "-1") or
            sign.find("validity") is None or
            (sign.find("validity").get("fromLane"), sign.find("validity").get("toLane")) != ("-1", "-1")):
        raise ValueError("Through signal lane placement differs")
    controls = root.findall("./controller/control")
    refs = root.findall("./junction[@id='158191']/controller")
    if (len(controls) != 1 or controls[0].get("signalId") != head.get("id") or
            len(refs) != 1 or refs[0].get("id") != root.find("./controller").get("id")):
        raise ValueError("Through head lacks junction controller")
    return {"site_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "ego_road_id": 158190, "ego_lane_id": -1,
            "through_road_ids": [158194, 158195, 158196],
            "junction_id": 158191, "yield_sign_id": sign.get("id"),
            "head_signal_id": head.get("id")}


def validate_config(config):
    authored = validate_authored_site()
    if (config.get("law_id"), config.get("cell_id"), config.get("actor")) != (
            "NRS-484B-257-1", "C158196", "motor_vehicle_driver"):
        raise ValueError("Wrong exact C158196 assignment")
    if config.get("selected_case_id") != PRIMARY:
        raise ValueError("Wrong exact visible non-governing case")
    if config.get("rate_hz") != 20 or config.get("duration_s") != 30:
        raise ValueError("Exact source capture needs 20 Hz for 30 seconds")
    if not isinstance(config.get("required_atoms"), list) or not isinstance(config.get("source_packets"), list):
        raise ValueError("Missing Core observation contract")
    cameras = config.get("cameras")
    if (not isinstance(cameras, list) or
            [item.get("name") for item in cameras] != list(CAMERAS) or
            any((item.get("width"), item.get("height")) != CAMERA_SIZES[item["name"]]
                or item.get("fov_deg") != 90 for item in cameras)):
        raise ValueError("Four original camera profile differs")
    site, context = config.get("site"), config.get("signal_context")
    if not isinstance(site, dict) or not isinstance(context, dict):
        raise ValueError("Missing authored signed intersection and signal context")
    if (site.get("xodr_sha256") != authored["site_sha256"] or
            site.get("approach_lanes", {}).get("ego") != [158190, -1] or
            site.get("approach_lanes", {}).get("through") not in
            ([158194, -1], [158196, 1])):
        raise ValueError("Signal configuration differs from authored OpenDRIVE site")
    if (site.get("native_map_id") != context.get("native_map_id") or
            site.get("approach_lanes", {}).get("ego") != context.get("ego_route_lanes", [None])[0] or
            site.get("approach_lanes", {}).get("through") != context.get("through_route_lanes", [None])[0] or
            config.get("signal_selector", {}).get("affected_lane") != site.get("approach_lanes", {}).get("through") or
            context.get("native_signal_id") is not None or
            config.get("target_signal_state") != "Green"):
        raise ValueError("Selected signal construction and source context differ")
    if any(not context.get(key) for key in ("affected_lane_source", "signal_head_video_source",
                                           "signed_entrance_source", "junction_source",
                                           "intersection_polygon_xy_m")):
        raise ValueError("Selected signal lacks sourced sign, head or junction geometry")
    for role in ("ego", "through"):
        pose = config.get("actor_transforms", {}).get(role)
        if (not isinstance(pose, dict) or
                set(pose) != {"location", "rotation"} or
                set(pose["location"]) != {"x", "y", "z"} or
                set(pose["rotation"]) != {"yaw", "pitch", "roll"}):
            raise ValueError("Explicit Native actor transform required: " + role)
    if not isinstance(config.get("camera_mounts"), dict) or set(config["camera_mounts"]) != set(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError("Four explicit camera mounts required")
    for name, mount in config["camera_mounts"].items():
        if (not isinstance(mount, dict) or set(mount) != {"pose", "attach_to"} or
                mount["attach_to"] not in (None, "ego", "through") or
                mount["pose"] is None):
            raise ValueError("Invalid exact source-camera mount: " + name)
    for role in ("ego", "through"):
        if not config.get("actor_blueprints", {}).get(role):
            raise ValueError("Missing exact Native vehicle blueprint: " + role)
        drive = config.get("drive", {}).get(role)
        if (not isinstance(drive, dict) or set(drive) != {"throttle", "brake", "steer"} or
                any(type(value) not in (int, float) for value in drive.values())):
            raise ValueError("Missing exact per-tick Native vehicle control: " + role)
    return config


def _transform(carla, pose):
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(**pose["location"]),
                           carla.Rotation(**pose["rotation"]))


def capture(config, output_dir, host, port):
    import carla
    from worker_exchange.native_output import seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot, restore

    output = Path(output_dir).resolve()
    if not output.is_dir() or not (output/"construction.json").is_file():
        raise ValueError("Materialize exact construction before Native capture")
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(30)
    saved = snapshot(client)
    failure = None
    summary = None
    try:
        world = client.generate_opendrive_world(SITE.read_text())
        if world.get_map().name != config["site"]["native_map_id"]:
            raise ValueError("Generated Native map name differs from exact configuration")
        lane = config["signal_selector"]["affected_lane"]
        light = find_governing_signal(world, lane[0], lane[1])
        context = dict(config["signal_context"], native_signal_id=light.id)
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 1/config["rate_hz"]
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        blueprints = {}
        for role in ("ego", "through"):
            blueprint = library.find(config["actor_blueprints"][role])
            blueprint.set_attribute("role_name", "c158196_257_1_" + role)
            blueprints[role] = blueprint
        camera_blueprints = {}
        for item in config["cameras"]:
            camera = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            camera.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(item["width"]))
            camera.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(item["height"]))
            camera.set_attribute("fov", str(item["fov_deg"]))
            camera_blueprints[item["name"]] = camera
        mounts = {name:{"transform":_transform(carla, value["pose"]),
                        "attach_to":value["attach_to"]}
                  for name,value in config["camera_mounts"].items()}
        transforms = {role:_transform(carla, pose)
                      for role,pose in config["actor_transforms"].items()}
        def drive(index, actors):
            for role, actor in actors.items():
                plan = config["drive"][role]
                actor.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(
                    throttle=plan["throttle"], brake=plan["brake"],
                    steer=plan["steer"]))
        summary = run_signal_capture(world, client, output, config["site"],
                           blueprints, transforms, carla.TrafficLightState,
                           config["target_signal_state"], light.id, False,
                           context, camera_blueprints, mounts,
                           config["selected_case_id"], config["required_atoms"],
                           drive, config["rate_hz"]*config["duration_s"])
    except Exception as error:
        failure = error
    try:
        restored = restore(client, saved)
    except Exception as error:
        (output/"native-run-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "case_id":config["selected_case_id"],"errors":[
                *([str(failure)] if failure else []),"World restoration failed: "+str(error)],
            "capture_sealed":False},allow_nan=False)+"\n")
        raise
    if failure is not None:
        (output/"native-run-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "case_id":config["selected_case_id"],"errors":[str(failure)],
            "capture_sealed":False},allow_nan=False)+"\n")
        raise failure
    try:
        seal_capture(output, frames=config["rate_hz"]*config["duration_s"],
                     restoration=restored, errors=[],
                     encoder_exit_codes=summary["encoder_exit_codes"],
                     context={"selected_case_id":config["selected_case_id"],
                              "official_signal_and_sign_review_pending":True})
    except Exception as error:
        (output/"native-run-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "case_id":config["selected_case_id"],"errors":["Capture seal failed: "+str(error)],
            "capture_sealed":False},allow_nan=False)+"\n")
        raise


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = validate_config(json.loads(Path("config.json").read_text()))
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps({"case_id":config["selected_case_id"],
                          "cpu_config_checked":True,"simulation_started":False}))
        return
    if not args.output_dir:
        raise ValueError("Native capture requires --output-dir")
    capture(config, args.output_dir, args.host, args.port)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Native traffic-light selection and reversible state control for C158196.

This controls a real CARLA signal actor; callers must separately retain image
evidence that its vehicular heads are installed and uncovered. A frozen phase is
not, by itself, evidence of an inoperative signal.
"""

from contextlib import contextmanager
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from queue import Empty, Queue


CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
CAMERA_SIZES = {"overview": (1920, 1080), "approach": (1280, 720),
                "reference_corner": (1280, 720), "driver_reference": (1280, 720)}


class FourCameraEncoder:
    """Retain four original BGRA sensor streams in lossless FFV1 containers."""

    def __init__(self, root, sizes=None, fps=20):
        self.root = Path(root)
        self.sizes = dict(CAMERA_SIZES if sizes is None else sizes)
        if set(self.sizes) != set(CAMERAS) or type(fps) is not int or fps <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Four named camera dimensions and integer rate required")
        if any(not isinstance(size, (tuple, list)) or len(size) != 2 or
               any(type(v) is not int or v <= 0 for v in size)
               for size in self.sizes.values()):
            raise ValueError("Invalid camera dimensions")
        self.fps = fps
        self.processes = {}
        self.count = 0

    def __enter__(self):
        self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if any((self.root / (name + ".mkv")).exists() for name in CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("Original camera video already exists")
        try:
            for name in CAMERAS:
                width, height = self.sizes[name]
                command = ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
                           "-f", "rawvideo", "-pixel_format", "bgra", "-video_size",
                           f"{width}x{height}", "-framerate", str(self.fps),
                           "-i", "pipe:0", "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-level", "3",
                           "-pix_fmt", "bgr0", str(self.root / (name + ".mkv"))]
                self.processes[name] = subprocess.Popen(command, stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                                                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                                        stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        except Exception:
            self._finish(abort=True)
            raise
        return self

    def validate_packets(self, packets):
        if set(packets) != set(CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("Four original camera packets required")
        for name in CAMERAS:
            packet = packets[name]
            width, height = self.sizes[name]
            if (packet.width, packet.height) != (width, height) or len(packet.raw_data) != width * height * 4:
                raise ValueError("Camera pixels differ from capture profile: " + name)

    def add_packets(self, packets):
        self.validate_packets(packets)
        for name in CAMERAS:
            self.processes[name].stdin.write(packets[name].raw_data)
        self.count += 1

    def _finish(self, abort=False):
        failures = []
        self.exit_codes = {}
        processes, self.processes = self.processes, {}
        for name, process in processes.items():
            if abort:
                if process.poll() is None:
                    process.kill()
            process.stdin.close()
            stderr = process.stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            process.stderr.close()
            code = process.wait()
            self.exit_codes[name] = code
            if not abort and (code != 0 or not (self.root / (name + ".mkv")).is_file()):
                failures.append(name + ": " + stderr[-400:])
        if failures:
            raise ValueError("Four-camera FFV1 encoding failed: " + "; ".join(failures))

    def __exit__(self, kind, value, trace):
        self._finish(abort=kind is not None)
        return False


class NativeSignalCapture:
    """Own four Native RGB sensors and capture the selected case per world tick.

    The caller supplies exact camera blueprints/mounts and drives the vehicles
    before each tick. An exception invalidates the attempt; raw source rows and
    videos are never silently repaired or reused as a successful capture.
    """

    def __init__(self, world, root, actors, light, context, expected_controls_ego,
                 camera_blueprints, camera_mounts, client, case_id, required_atoms,
                 sizes=None, sensor_timeout_s=10, capture_factory=None):
        self.world, self.root, self.actors, self.light = world, Path(root), actors, light
        self.context, self.expected_controls_ego = context, expected_controls_ego
        self.camera_blueprints, self.camera_mounts = camera_blueprints, camera_mounts
        self.client, self.case_id, self.required_atoms = client, case_id, required_atoms
        self.capture_factory = capture_factory
        if not client or not isinstance(case_id, str) or not case_id or not isinstance(required_atoms, (list, tuple)):
            raise ValueError("Original PipelineCapture identity and Core atoms required")
        self.sizes = sizes
        self.sensor_timeout_s = _finite(sensor_timeout_s, "sensor timeout")
        if (not isinstance(actors, dict) or set(actors) != {"ego", "through"} or
                set(camera_blueprints) != set(CAMERAS) or set(camera_mounts) != set(CAMERAS)):
            raise ValueError("Exact actor pair and four camera mounts required")
        self.sensors = {}
        self.queues = {}
        self.encoder = None
        self.writer = None
        self.pipeline_capture = None

    def __enter__(self):
        try:
            for name in CAMERAS:
                mount = self.camera_mounts[name]
                if not isinstance(mount, dict) or set(mount) != {"transform", "attach_to"}:
                    raise ValueError("Camera mount needs exact transform and attachment: " + name)
                role = mount["attach_to"]
                if role not in (None, "ego", "through"):
                    raise ValueError("Unknown camera attachment: " + name)
                options = {} if role is None else {"attach_to": self.actors[role]}
                sensor = self.world.spawn_actor(self.camera_blueprints[name],
                                                mount["transform"], **options)
                if sensor is None:
                    raise ValueError("Native camera spawn failed: " + name)
                self.sensors[name] = sensor
                queue = Queue()
                self.queues[name] = queue
                sensor.listen(queue.put)
            self.encoder = FourCameraEncoder(self.root, self.sizes)
            self.encoder.__enter__()
            if self.capture_factory is None:
                from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
                self.capture_factory = PipelineCapture
            self.pipeline_capture = self.capture_factory(
                self.client, self.actors["ego"], self.root, self.case_id,
                required_observations=self.required_atoms)
            self.writer = SignalSourceWriter(self.root, self.context)
            return self
        except Exception:
            self._close(True)
            raise

    def capture_tick(self):
        frame = self.world.tick()
        if type(frame) is not int:
            raise ValueError("Native tick did not return a frame identity")
        packets = {}
        for name in CAMERAS:
            try:
                packet = self.queues[name].get(timeout=self.sensor_timeout_s)
            except Empty as exc:
                raise ValueError("Missing original camera frame: " + name) from exc
            if packet.frame != frame:
                raise ValueError("Stale or future original camera frame: " + name)
            packets[name] = packet
        self.encoder.validate_packets(packets)
        observation = self.writer.add_tick(self.world, self.actors["ego"], self.light,
                                           packets, self.expected_controls_ego,
                                           through=self.actors["through"])
        self.encoder.add_packets(packets)
        self.pipeline_capture.capture(frame, observation[0]["time_s"])
        return observation

    def _close(self, abort):
        try:
            if self.pipeline_capture is not None:
                self.pipeline_capture.close(confirmed=not abort)
        finally:
            try:
                for sensor in reversed(list(self.sensors.values())):
                    try:
                        sensor.stop()
                    finally:
                        sensor.destroy()
            finally:
                if self.encoder is not None and self.encoder.processes:
                    self.encoder._finish(abort=abort)

    def __exit__(self, kind, value, trace):
        self._close(abort=kind is not None)
        return False


def _finite(value, label):
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError("Missing finite " + label)
    return float(value)


class SignalSourceWriter:
    """Append original same-tick signal, body and four-camera identities.

    The caller owns camera encoding and passes original CARLA sensor packets.
    This writer never repairs a missing sensor frame or infers signal control
    from an image. The saved video producer must use the same packet order.
    """

    def __init__(self, root, context):
        self.root = Path(root)
        self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.context = dict(context)
        required = ("native_map_id", "intersection_id", "ego_road_id", "ego_lane_id",
                    "native_signal_id", "affected_lane_source", "signal_head_video_source",
                    "signed_entrance_source", "junction_source", "intersection_polygon_xy_m",
                    "ego_route_lanes")
        if any(self.context.get(key) is None for key in required):
            raise ValueError("Incomplete original signal context")
        route = self.context["ego_route_lanes"]
        if (not isinstance(route,list) or not route or route[0] !=
                [self.context["ego_road_id"],self.context["ego_lane_id"]] or
                any(not isinstance(pair,list) or len(pair)!=2 or
                    any(type(v) is not int for v in pair) for pair in route)):
            raise ValueError("Sourced ego approach and route lanes required")
        self.paths = [self.root / name for name in
                      ("signal_context.json", "signal_history.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl",
                       "interaction_history.jsonl", "control_context.json")]
        if any(path.exists() for path in self.paths):
            raise ValueError("Original signal source already exists")
        self.paths[0].write_text(json.dumps(self.context, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        self.paths[4].write_text(json.dumps({
            "intersection_xy_m": self.context["intersection_polygon_xy_m"],
            "native_map_id": self.context["native_map_id"],
            "intersection_id": self.context["intersection_id"]},
            sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        self.count = 0
        self.previous = None

    def add_tick(self, world, ego, light, camera_packets, expected_controls_ego,
                 through=None):
        if type(expected_controls_ego) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("Expected Native lane governance is required")
        if not isinstance(camera_packets, dict) or set(camera_packets) != set(CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("Four named original camera packets required")
        snapshot = world.get_snapshot()
        frame = snapshot.frame
        time_s = _finite(snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds, "Native timestamp")
        if type(frame) is not int or frame < 0 or (self.previous and
                (frame <= self.previous[0] or time_s <= self.previous[1])):
            raise ValueError("Nonmonotone Native frame")
        for name in CAMERAS:
            packet = camera_packets[name]
            if packet.frame != frame or abs(_finite(packet.timestamp, name + " timestamp") - time_s) > 1e-3:
                raise ValueError("Camera frame or timestamp differs from Native tick: " + name)
            if (type(packet.width) is not int or type(packet.height) is not int or
                    packet.width <= 0 or packet.height <= 0 or
                    len(packet.raw_data) != packet.width * packet.height * 4):
                raise ValueError("Missing original camera pixels: " + name)
        native_map = world.get_map()
        if native_map.name != self.context["native_map_id"] or light.id != self.context["native_signal_id"]:
            raise ValueError("Original map or signal identity changed")
        transform = ego.get_transform()
        waypoint = native_map.get_waypoint(transform.location, project_to_road=False)
        if waypoint is None or [waypoint.road_id, waypoint.lane_id] not in self.context["ego_route_lanes"]:
            raise ValueError("Ego left sourced signal route")
        if self.count==0 and [waypoint.road_id,waypoint.lane_id] != [
                self.context["ego_road_id"],self.context["ego_lane_id"]]:
            raise ValueError("Ego did not start on sourced signal approach")
        governed = {(wp.road_id, wp.lane_id) for wp in light.get_affected_lane_waypoints()}
        controls = (self.context["ego_road_id"],self.context["ego_lane_id"]) in governed
        if controls is not expected_controls_ego:
            raise ValueError("Native signal governance changed during capture")
        state = str(light.get_state()).split(".")[-1]
        if state not in ("Red", "Yellow", "Green", "Off"):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported original signal indication")
        vertices = ego.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(transform)
        if len(vertices) < 4:
            raise ValueError("Incomplete original ego body")
        body = [[_finite(vertex.x, "body x"), _finite(vertex.y, "body y")]
                for vertex in vertices]
        velocity = ego.get_velocity()
        speed = math.sqrt(sum(_finite(getattr(velocity, axis), "ego velocity")**2
                              for axis in ("x", "y", "z")))
        interaction = None
        if through is not None:
            if any(self.context.get(key) is None for key in ("through_road_id", "through_lane_id")):
                raise ValueError("Missing sourced through-highway lane")
            through_transform = through.get_transform()
            through_waypoint = native_map.get_waypoint(through_transform.location,
                                                       project_to_road=False)
            through_route = self.context.get("through_route_lanes")
            if (not isinstance(through_route,list) or not through_route or
                    through_route[0] != [self.context["through_road_id"],self.context["through_lane_id"]] or
                    through_waypoint is None or
                    [through_waypoint.road_id, through_waypoint.lane_id] not in through_route):
                raise ValueError("Through actor left sourced highway route")
            def vertices3(actor, actor_transform):
                points = actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(actor_transform)
                if len(points) < 4:
                    raise ValueError("Incomplete original actor body")
                return [[_finite(p.x, "body x"), _finite(p.y, "body y"),
                         _finite(p.z, "body z")] for p in points]
            through_velocity = through.get_velocity()
            through_speed = math.sqrt(sum(_finite(getattr(through_velocity, axis),
                                                  "through velocity")**2
                                          for axis in ("x", "y", "z")))
            location = type(transform.location)
            eye = transform.transform(location(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.5))
            target = through_transform.transform(location(x=0.0, y=0.0, z=1.2))
            def xyz(point):
                return [_finite(getattr(point, axis), "sight point")
                        for axis in ("x", "y", "z")]
            blockers = []
            for hit in world.cast_ray(eye, target):
                if (ego.bounding_box.contains(hit.location, transform) or
                        through.bounding_box.contains(hit.location, through_transform) or
                        hit.location.distance(eye) < .05 or
                        hit.location.distance(target) < .02):
                    continue
                blockers.append({"label": str(hit.label), "location_m": xyz(hit.location)})
            interaction = {"frame": frame, "time_s": time_s,
                           "ego": {"body_vertices_m": vertices3(ego, transform),
                                   "road_id": waypoint.road_id, "lane_id": waypoint.lane_id},
                           "through": {"body_vertices_m": vertices3(through, through_transform),
                                       "actor_id": through.id,
                                       "position_m": xyz(through_transform.location),
                                       "speed_mps": through_speed,
                                       "road_id": through_waypoint.road_id,
                                       "lane_id": through_waypoint.lane_id},
                           "through_sight": {"observer_m": xyz(eye),
                                             "target_m": xyz(target),
                                             "method": "native_collision_ray_to_through_actor_center",
                                             "blockers": blockers,
                                             "clear": not blockers,
                                             "sampled_only": True}}
        if world.get_snapshot().frame != frame:
            raise ValueError("World advanced during source observation")
        row = {"frame": frame, "time_s": time_s, "native_signal_id": light.id,
               "ego_road_id": waypoint.road_id, "ego_lane_id": waypoint.lane_id,
               "signal_state": state, "signal_controls_ego": controls,
               "ego_speed_mps": speed, "ego_body_vertices_xy_m": body}
        frame_row = {"video_frame": self.count, "carla_frame": frame, "native_frame": frame,
                     "time_s": time_s,
                     "camera_frames": {name: camera_packets[name].frame for name in CAMERAS}}
        for path, value in zip(self.paths[1:], (row, frame_row)):
            with path.open("a") as handle:
                handle.write(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        if interaction is not None:
            with self.paths[3].open("a") as handle:
                handle.write(json.dumps(interaction, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        self.previous = (frame, time_s)
        self.count += 1
        return row, frame_row


def find_governing_signal(world, road_id, lane_id):
    """Choose only a signal whose affected Native waypoint matches the approach."""
    matches = []
    for light in world.get_actors().filter("traffic.traffic_light*"):
        affected = light.get_affected_lane_waypoints()
        if any(wp.road_id == road_id and wp.lane_id == lane_id for wp in affected):
            matches.append(light)
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected one governing traffic light, found {len(matches)}")
    return matches[0]


class SignalControl:
    """Apply a requested Native signal state and restore the actor afterward."""

    def __init__(self, world, light, states, target):
        if target not in ("Red", "Green", "Off"):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported target state")
        self.world, self.light, self.states, self.target = world, light, states, target
        self.original = None

    def __enter__(self):
        self.original = self.light.get_state()
        self.light.freeze(True)
        try:
            self.light.set_state(getattr(self.states, self.target))
            self.world.tick()
            if self.light.get_state() != getattr(self.states, self.target):
                raise ValueError("Traffic light state readback failed")
        except Exception:
            self.light.set_state(self.original)
            self.light.freeze(False)
            raise
        return self.light

    def __exit__(self, *_):
        self.light.set_state(self.original)
        self.light.freeze(False)
        self.world.tick()
        if self.light.get_state() != self.original:
            raise ValueError("Traffic light restoration readback failed")


@contextmanager
def construct_signal_comparison(world, site, blueprints, transforms, states,
                                target_state, signal_id, expected_controls_ego):
    """Spawn an ego/through pair and read back the selected signal's lane control.

    A selected head can govern the ego entrance or another entrance. This
    construction verifies Native lane relationships; sign propriety, head
    visibility and legal control remain separate source-review questions.
    """
    native_map = world.get_map()
    if native_map.name != site.get("native_map_id"):
        raise ValueError("Native map differs from selected signed intersection")
    lanes = site.get("approach_lanes")
    if (not isinstance(lanes, dict) or set(lanes) != {"ego", "through"} or
            any(not isinstance(lanes[role], list) or len(lanes[role]) != 2 or
                any(type(v) is not int for v in lanes[role]) for role in lanes) or
            lanes["ego"] == lanes["through"]):
        raise ValueError("Two distinct sourced approach lanes required")
    if (set(blueprints) != {"ego", "through"} or
            set(transforms) != {"ego", "through"} or
            type(signal_id) is not int or signal_id <= 0 or
            type(expected_controls_ego) is not bool):
        raise ValueError("Exact actor and signal construction inputs required")
    owned = []
    try:
        actors = {}
        for role in ("ego", "through"):
            actor = world.try_spawn_actor(blueprints[role], transforms[role])
            if actor is None:
                raise ValueError("Native vehicle spawn failed: " + role)
            owned.append(actor)
            waypoint = native_map.get_waypoint(actor.get_location(), project_to_road=False)
            if (waypoint is None or
                    [int(waypoint.road_id), int(waypoint.lane_id)] != lanes[role]):
                raise ValueError("Native vehicle outside selected approach lane: " + role)
            actors[role] = actor
        lights = [light for light in world.get_actors().filter("traffic.traffic_light*")
                  if light.id == signal_id]
        if len(lights) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Exact selected Native signal actor required")
        light = lights[0]
        governed = {(int(wp.road_id), int(wp.lane_id))
                    for wp in light.get_affected_lane_waypoints()}
        controls_ego = tuple(lanes["ego"]) in governed
        if controls_ego is not expected_controls_ego:
            raise ValueError("Selected signal governance differs from comparison case")
        with SignalControl(world, light, states, target_state):
            yield {"actors": actors, "signal": light,
                   "signal_controls_ego": controls_ego,
                   "physical_head_visibility_verified": False,
                   "legal_exception_verified": False}
    finally:
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            actor.destroy()


def run_signal_capture(world, client, root, site, blueprints, transforms, states,
                       target_state, signal_id, expected_controls_ego, context,
                       camera_blueprints, camera_mounts, case_id, required_atoms,
                       drive, frames, sizes=None, capture_factory=None,
                       yield_context=None):
    """Construct a selected signal case and retain its joined original sources.

    ``drive`` applies case-specific actor controls before each Native tick. It
    cannot supply source observations; NativeSignalCapture reads those back.
    """
    if type(frames) is not int or frames < 3 or not callable(drive):
        raise ValueError("A driven three-frame-or-longer Native capture is required")
    if (context.get("native_map_id") != site.get("native_map_id") or
            context.get("ego_route_lanes", [None])[0] != site.get("approach_lanes", {}).get("ego") or
            context.get("through_route_lanes", [None])[0] != site.get("approach_lanes", {}).get("through") or
            context.get("native_signal_id") != signal_id):
        raise ValueError("Capture context differs from selected Native construction")
    is_yield_baseline = case_id.endswith("__yield_without_signal_control")
    if is_yield_baseline != (yield_context is not None):
        raise ValueError("Yield baseline requires its exact authored source context")
    if yield_context is not None:
        if (yield_context.get("native_map_id") != context["native_map_id"] or
                yield_context.get("intersection_id") != context["intersection_id"] or
                yield_context.get("ego_approach_lane") !=
                [context["ego_road_id"], context["ego_lane_id"]] or
                yield_context.get("through_highway_lane") !=
                [context.get("through_road_id"), context.get("through_lane_id")] or
                yield_context.get("sign_type") != "yield" or
                yield_context.get("stop_line_present") is not False or
                yield_context.get("near_crosswalk_present") is not False):
            raise ValueError("Authored yield source differs from selected signed intersection")
    with construct_signal_comparison(world, site, blueprints, transforms, states,
                                     target_state, signal_id, expected_controls_ego) as built:
        with NativeSignalCapture(world, root, built["actors"], built["signal"], context,
                                 expected_controls_ego, camera_blueprints, camera_mounts,
                                 client, case_id, required_atoms, sizes=sizes,
                                 capture_factory=capture_factory) as capture:
            for index in range(frames):
                drive(index, built["actors"])
                capture.capture_tick()
            if capture.encoder.count != frames or capture.writer.count != frames:
                raise ValueError("Native signal source frame count differs from capture plan")
            if yield_context is not None:
                path = Path(root)/"yield_context.json"
                with path.open("x") as source:
                    source.write(json.dumps(yield_context, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)+"\n")
    return {"case_id": case_id, "source_frames": frames,
            "source_videos": [name+".mkv" for name in CAMERAS],
            "encoder_exit_codes": dict(capture.encoder.exit_codes),
            "physical_or_legal_acceptance_claimed": False}

"""Observe active controlling traffic signal at signed-entrance ego entry.

An illuminated light elsewhere at the junction is insufficient. The output
preserves control and timing facts without a legal exception conclusion.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import math
import argparse
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from shapely.geometry import LineString, MultiPoint, Polygon


REQUIRED=("signal_context.json","signal_history.jsonl","video_frames.jsonl")
CAMERAS=("overview","approach","reference_corner","driver_reference")


def _number(value,label):
    if isinstance(value,bool) or not isinstance(value,(int,float)) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError("Missing finite "+label)
    return float(value)


def _rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def analyze(root:Path)->dict:
    root=Path(root);hashes={}
    for name in REQUIRED:
        path=root/name
        if not path.is_file():raise ValueError("Missing original source: "+name)
        hashes[name]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    ctx=json.loads((root/"signal_context.json").read_text())
    for key in ("native_map_id","intersection_id","ego_road_id","ego_lane_id",
                "native_signal_id","affected_lane_source","signal_head_video_source",
                "signed_entrance_source","junction_source"):
        if ctx.get(key) is None:raise ValueError("Missing sourced signal context: "+key)
    polygon=Polygon(ctx.get("intersection_polygon_xy_m",[]))
    if not polygon.is_valid or polygon.area<=0:raise ValueError("Invalid intersection polygon")
    route=ctx.get("ego_route_lanes")
    if (not isinstance(route,list) or not route or route[0]!=[ctx["ego_road_id"],ctx["ego_lane_id"]]):
        raise ValueError("Missing sourced ego approach route")
    rows,frames=_rows(root/"signal_history.jsonl"),_rows(root/"video_frames.jsonl")
    if len(rows)<3 or len(rows)!=len(frames):raise ValueError("Incomplete signal/ego history")
    previous=(-1,-math.inf);samples=[];first_entry=None
    for i,(row,frame) in enumerate(zip(rows,frames)):
        fid,time=row.get("frame"),_number(row.get("time_s"),"time")
        if type(fid) is not int or fid<=previous[0] or time<=previous[1]:
            raise ValueError("Nonmonotone original history")
        previous=fid,time
        if frame.get("video_frame")!=i or frame.get("carla_frame")!=fid or frame.get("time_s")!=time:
            raise ValueError("Original frame join failed")
        camera_frames=frame.get("camera_frames")
        if (not isinstance(camera_frames,dict) or set(camera_frames)!=set(CAMERAS) or
                any(camera_frames[name]!=fid for name in CAMERAS)):
            raise ValueError("Four original camera frame joins required")
        if row.get("native_signal_id")!=ctx["native_signal_id"]:
            raise ValueError("Native governing light identity mismatch")
        observed_lane=[row.get("ego_road_id"),row.get("ego_lane_id")]
        if observed_lane not in route or (i==0 and observed_lane!=route[0]):
            raise ValueError("Ego outside sourced signal route")
        state=row.get("signal_state")
        if state not in ("Red","Yellow","Green","Off"):
            raise ValueError("Signal state missing")
        controls=row.get("signal_controls_ego")
        if type(controls) is not bool:raise ValueError("Missing affected-lane control observation")
        speed=_number(row.get("ego_speed_mps"),"ego speed")
        if speed<0:raise ValueError("Negative speed")
        vertices=row.get("ego_body_vertices_xy_m")
        if not isinstance(vertices,list) or len(vertices)<4:raise ValueError("Missing complete ego body")
        body=MultiPoint([(_number(p[0],"body x"),_number(p[1],"body y")) for p in vertices]).convex_hull
        inside=body.intersects(polygon)
        if i==0 and inside:raise ValueError("Missing pre-entry approach")
        if inside and first_entry is None:
            first_entry={"frame":fid,"time_s":time,"signal_state":state,
                         "signal_controls_ego":controls}
        samples.append({"frame":fid,"time_s":time,"signal_state":state,
                        "signal_controls_ego":controls,"ego_speed_mps":speed,
                        "ego_body_in_intersection":inside})
    if first_entry is None:raise ValueError("No observed ego entry")
    active=first_entry["signal_controls_ego"] and first_entry["signal_state"]!="Off"
    return {"format":"worker-controlling-signal-exception-observations","sources":hashes,
            "first_ego_entry":first_entry,"operative_signal_controls_ego_at_entry_observed":active,
            "samples":samples,"official_control_judgment":"unresolved pending source review",
            "legal_exception_judgment":"unresolved","legal_conclusion":"unresolved"}

def measure_yield_baseline(attempt, context, interaction, frames, review):
    """Retain the yield reference and through traffic facts without judging hazard."""
    source = attempt/"yield_context.json"
    if not source.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: yield_context.json")
    baseline = json.loads(source.read_text())
    if review.get("yield_context_sha256") != hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest():
        raise ValueError("Original-camera review yield context hash differs")
    if (baseline.get("native_map_id") != context["native_map_id"] or
            baseline.get("intersection_id") != context["intersection_id"] or
            baseline.get("ego_approach_lane") != [context["ego_road_id"], context["ego_lane_id"]] or
            baseline.get("through_highway_lane") != [context.get("through_road_id"), context.get("through_lane_id")]):
        raise ValueError("Yield reference differs from original signed intersection")
    if (baseline.get("stop_line_present") is not False or
            baseline.get("near_crosswalk_present") is not False or
            baseline.get("sign_type") != "yield" or
            not isinstance(baseline.get("source_description"), str) or
            not baseline["source_description"].strip()):
        raise ValueError("Nearest-view yield reference lacks sourced hierarchy")
    observations = review["observations"]
    for key in ("yield_sign_visible", "no_stop_line_visible", "no_near_crosswalk_visible",
                "nearest_view_reference_reviewed"):
        if observations.get(key) is not True:
            raise ValueError("Yield hierarchy lacks original-camera review: " + key)
    if observations.get("officer_control_observed") is not False:
        raise ValueError("Yield baseline requires reviewed absence of officer control")
    points = baseline.get("nearest_view_line_xy_m")
    if (not isinstance(points, list) or len(points) != 2 or
            any(not isinstance(p, list) or len(p) != 2 for p in points)):
        raise ValueError("Missing sourced nearest-view line")
    line = LineString([(_number(p[0], "reference x"), _number(p[1], "reference y"))
                       for p in points])
    if line.length <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Degenerate nearest-view line")
    polygon = Polygon(context["intersection_polygon_xy_m"])
    if line.intersects(polygon):
        raise ValueError("Nearest-view reference lies inside intersection")
    first_reference = None
    first_entry = None
    through_at_entry = None
    through_route = context.get("through_route_lanes")
    if (not isinstance(through_route, list) or not through_route or
            through_route[0] != baseline["through_highway_lane"]):
        raise ValueError("Missing sourced through-highway route")
    for frame, bodies in zip(frames, interaction):
        if ([bodies["ego"].get("road_id"), bodies["ego"].get("lane_id")] not in
                context["ego_route_lanes"] or
                [bodies["through"].get("road_id"), bodies["through"].get("lane_id")] not in
                through_route):
            raise ValueError("Original body left sourced yield/highway route")
        ego = MultiPoint([(_number(p[0], "ego body x"), _number(p[1], "ego body y"))
                          for p in bodies["ego"]["body_vertices_m"]]).convex_hull
        through = MultiPoint([(_number(p[0], "through body x"), _number(p[1], "through body y"))
                              for p in bodies["through"]["body_vertices_m"]]).convex_hull
        if first_reference is None and ego.intersects(line):
            first_reference = frame["carla_frame"]
        if first_entry is None and ego.intersects(polygon):
            first_entry = frame["carla_frame"]
            through_at_entry = through.intersects(polygon)
    if first_reference is None or first_entry is None or first_reference >= first_entry:
        raise ValueError("Original ego body did not cross nearest-view reference before entry")
    return {"nearest_view_reference_frame": first_reference,
            "first_ego_entry_frame": first_entry,
            "through_body_in_intersection_at_entry": through_at_entry,
            "immediate_hazard_judgment": "unresolved",
            "right_of_way_judgment": "unresolved",
            "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}

            "comparison_id":comparison_id,"case_ids":[first[0],second[0]],

def validate_source_camera_review(attempt, frames, case_id):

        raise ValueError("Four original-camera review hashes required")
